Hi Stefan

1. You'll be pleased to know that archiving directly from the notification IS available. First you need to add "archive" as one of the three notification actions. Navigate to settings > general settings > notifications: Notification Actions.

Once added, an archive button will be available on the notification. See the attached screen shots.

2. I'm not a TB desktop user so not familiar with the "time stamped directory option for archiving". There's nothing in the mobile app currently beyond basic archiving.

There is a app feature under development that may be what your thinking of. It proposes to create date stamped archives, rather than time stamped ones. See the below link for more info. No guarentee if/when it will be implemented.

https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/pull/10113

3. The best place to raise feature requests and share ideas is on Mozilla Connect. Community members can then vote for them.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/idb-p/ideas/label-name/thunderbird%20android
